summary: Saddam Chat app with role-based access and routing: post-login redirects to /chat for approved users and admins; only unapproved users see Pending Approval; super_admin can access user management from chat header; UI branding uses "Saddam Chat" instead of "Admin Portal".
architectural_notes: Role-based routing rules: super_admin/admin/approved users land on /chat; only unapproved users see Pending Approval.
super_admin should have persistent access to /admin/users independent of approval status.
known_issues: Branding incorrectly shows "Admin Portal" instead of "Saddam Chat" in some UI/meta locations.
Post-login routing may incorrectly send admin/super_admin to dashboard-only screens or approval flow.
super_admin may lack direct access to user management/user list from chat header.

existing_features.title: Replace all user-facing occurrences of the string "Admin Portal" with "Saddam Chat" across the frontend, including (at minimum) the app header, screen titles/headings, and the HTML document title/meta in frontend/index.html.

Update post-login redirect logic so that after a successful login: super_admin redirects to /chat by default; admin redirects to /chat; approved non-admin users redirect to /chat; only unapproved non-admin users redirect to /pending-approval. Ensure admin/super_admin never get sent to the Pending Approval screen due to an approval flag check order.

Ensure the User Management screen at route /admin/users is accessible from the Chat experience via the header dropdown menu for super_admin users (i.e., from the Chat screen header menu, super_admin can navigate to /admin/users).

Remove any routing/guard behavior that blocks super_admin or admin users behind dashboard-only screens (e.g., do not force admins to land on /admin or require visiting /admin before accessing other allowed routes). Admin and super_admin should be able to access /chat and other non-authenticated routes permitted by login without being redirected to dashboard-only pages.

Ensure super_admin always has access to the user list (/admin/users) without being routed through or blocked by the approval flow (Pending Approval). Any approval gating must apply only to non-admin users.

new_feature_requests.summary: Replace all occurrences of "Admin Portal" with app name "Saddam Chat" (header, titles, meta)
Update post-login routing: super_admin/admin/approved user -> /chat; only unapproved users -> Pending Approval screen
Expose User Management (/admin/users) in Chat header menu for super_admin
Do not block super_admin or admin behind dashboard-only screens
Ensure super_admin always has user list access without going through approval flow
